title: Task
description: evals/tasks/**/<id>.yaml. The unit of work: an input, a reference solution, and binary checks. A task reports both strict pass (all checks) and a weighted score.

id.description: Must equal the file name without extension.

suite.description: The suite this task belongs to. Must exist under evals/suites/.

source.description: Where the task came from: trace:<trace id> for a promoted trace, spec:<slug> for a capability task written from the spec, synthetic:<slug> for generated input.

description.description: One or two sentences on what this task tests.

input.description: What the agent receives. Free shape; the sample repo uses { persona, message }.

reference_solution.description: Path to a reference_solution JSON that must pass every check before the task can join a suite.

graduated_from.description: Set when a saturated capability task moved to regression.

covers.description: Parts of the application this task covers, for `litmustest coverage`: spec ids (SYS-LOOP-03), routes ("POST /api/play/join") or tool names. Adds to what `source: spec:<id>` and the trials' own calls already count.
